`@kerfjs/ui:wa-dropdown` · Web Awesome · component · Actions · recommendation: avoid

## When to use

Ecosystem action menu; use Kerf PopupMenu, or Select when choosing a value.

- Action-menu primitive; prefer Kerf Select when choosing a value.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use PopupMenu for a command menu and Select for a value.

**Alternatives:**

- [PopupMenu](./popup-menu.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use PopupMenu for a command menu and Select for a value.
- [Select](./select.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use PopupMenu for a command menu and Select for a value.
